title: Moving Stones Until Consecutive
description:
Three stones occupy distinct integer positions on a line. In one move, move an endpoint stone to an unoccupied integer position strictly between the current endpoints. Return `[minimumMoves, maximumMoves]` needed to make the positions consecutive.

## Examples

```text
Input: a = 1, b = 2, c = 5
Output: [1,2]
```

```text
Input: a = 4, b = 3, c = 2
Output: [0,0]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= a, b, c <= 100`
- The three positions are distinct
